name: MiniApp Factory
description: A bright visual studio for deterministic MiniApp starter packages, testnet template verification, wallet registration, refresh recovery, and operator handoff. Registration writes a Factory record; it does not deploy or publish a finished app.
description_zh: 明亮直观的小程序创建工作台，支持确定性启动包、测试网模板核验、钱包登记、刷新恢复和运营交接。登记只会写入 Factory 记录，不会部署或发布完整应用。

aa.description: Template plans can be submitted by AA later, but this standalone app does not require AA.

tee.description: No private computation is required for deterministic miniapp planning.

neodid.description: Developer identity can be layered on top by signing the generated template plan.
